title: Socially Fair Center-based and Linear Subspace Clustering
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith/religion. It focuses on fairness in clustering algorithms across demographic groups defined by features like race, gender, age, and education.
findings: There are no findings related to religion as the paper does not study this topic.
